caption:
Arcs and sectors are just fractions of a circle.

120° is 1/3 of 360°, so on a radius-6 circle the arc is 1/3 of 12π (4π) and the sector is 1/3 of 36π (12π).

Save this for your next circle question.
tiktok_caption: Arcs and sectors are just fractions of a circle. Find the fraction first.

youtube.title: Arc Length and Sector Area: Just Use a Fraction
youtube.description: A central angle takes the same fraction of the circumference and the area as it does of 360°. Example: 120° on a radius-6 circle gives an arc of 4π and a sector of 12π.
